conditions: x is any finite real number. exp and ln have their real meanings; atan is the real inverse tangent with values in (-pi/2,pi/2).
The integrand is smooth on the entire real axis. An explicit exact antiderivative is required on that whole connected domain, up to one global additive constant.
All expressions are interpreted exactly; large positive or negative x must not create symbolic domain exclusions.
x is real with x<=-1 or x>=1, the entire real domain of the original integrand. sqrt is the nonnegative real square root, and atan is the real inverse tangent.
An explicit exact antiderivative is required separately on (-infinity,-1) and (1,infinity), allowing independent additive constants on these disconnected intervals.

The primitive must extend continuously to the included endpoints. At -1 its left derivative and at 1 its right derivative must equal the integrand value zero. No two-sided real derivative at either endpoint is asserted.
